ver.session.note: R344 — recorded live in a studio for radio, TV or a website.

ed.play_album.note: R373 — the album page's primary button and the first item of its ▾ menu: the official album.

ed.play_extras.note: R373 — the second ▾ item: the official album, then the extras, then the B-sides (305 Q3).

ed.edition.note: R373 — the divider above an album's extras; {edition} is MusicBrainz's own title or note as it is, or a country name.

ed.bonus.note: R373 — a chip after the version chips: a song that is official on no album.

support.title.note: The support lane (DEB-1501): the Profile row and the web menu's item. Opens My tickets.

support.write.note: The primary button on an empty list, the quieter one at the foot of the list, and the first-message heading.

support.placeholder_reopen.note: The composer's placeholder on a resolved ticket: writing there reopens it.

support.first_hint: Tell us what happened and where — which TV or phone helps.

support.sent_from_phone.text: Sent from Ravilo on the phone · {name}
support.sent_from_phone.note: Phone only. {name} is the phone's own name.

support.you.note: Heads the viewer's own bubble; {name} is the viewer.

support.badge_support.note: Badge on Hervør's bubbles, and the name for a ticket held by an admin or the team: "Open · with support".

support.badge_ai.note: Badge beside AI Agent and Hervør.

support.pres_waiting.text: Open · waiting for a first reply
support.pres_waiting.note: The presence line while nobody but the viewer has written.

support.pres_with.note: The presence line; {name} is AI Agent or Hervør. The desk has its own line, support.pres_with_support, because Faroese declines the word (DEB-2181, FR-11b).

support.sys_received.note: The receipt, once the ticket has a class and a title. {class} is support.class_* in lower case.

support.sys_handling.note: A forward notice; {name} is AI Agent or Hervør. The desk has support.sys_handling_support.

support.not_sent_offline: Not sent — you're offline. Your message is kept here.
support.offline_bar: Offline — showing what was last loaded

support.show_rest.note: Inside a bubble clamped at 14 lines.

support.empty_body: Something wrong, or something you wish Ravilo did? Write to support — a reply usually comes within minutes.

support.tv_said_same_here.note: A SAME_HERE entry, written from a TV.

support.ticket_n.note: DEB-1501 — the title while a ticket has none.

support.sys_received_bare.note: DEB-1501 — the receipt before the ticket has both a class and a title.

support.limit.text: You've written a lot today. Try again later.

support.too_long.text: That's too long to send in one message.

support.pres_with_support.note: DEB-2181 (FR-11b) — the presence line of a ticket the desk holds (ADMIN, TEAM, or an unknown holder). Not composed from support.pres_with: Faroese declines the word.

support.sys_handling_support.note: DEB-2181 (FR-11b) — a FORWARDED line to the desk. Not composed from support.sys_handling: Faroese declines the word.

country.JP.note: R373 — the extras divider names a country when MusicBrainz names no edition (305 owner decision 3).

migrate.unknown.note: DEB-2051 (FR-10) — the AVI→MKV conversion notice on the admin's media page. Placeholders: {track} {lang} {file} {title} {need} {free} {step} {n}. Danish and Faroese are drafts awaiting the owner's read on the QA row (Acceptance 6).

migrate.notKept: Not kept — this AVI can’t store a language.
migrate.why: Why, and what you can do
migrate.stillFail: Still Unknown — the conversion to MKV didn’t finish.
migrate.stillUnv: Still Unknown — the new file had no language tag.
migrate.blkRow: Not kept — converting this file to MKV is blocked right now.
migrate.pthRow: Not kept — migration is unavailable for this file.
migrate.limTitle: This AVI can’t keep an audio language
migrate.limBody: AVI has no place to store a language for {track}, so {lang} can’t be saved in this file. Converting the file to MKV can keep it.
migrate.streamCopy: Video and audio are copied without re-encoding
migrate.keepNote: Keep as AVI: the language stays Unknown and the track stays in Triage.
migrate.pvTitle: Convert to MKV — what would change
migrate.estVal: about 2 minutes · 1.4 GB of temporary space
migrate.tempWhere: Temporary files go in a hidden folder beside the source, on the same disk.
migrate.estUnkBody: Time and temporary space can’t be worked out for this file.
migrate.beforeVal: Torrent safety is checked again when you press Start migration.
migrate.oldVal: {file} moves into a hidden folder beside the new file and is kept until you remove it.
migrate.srcStays: Stays in place until the new file is verified
migrate.blkTitle: This file can’t be converted right now
migrate.seedShort: This file is linked to an active seeding torrent
migrate.seedLong: This file is shared with a torrent that is still seeding (hard link), so it can’t be changed in place.
migrate.unkShort: The torrent safety check couldn’t be reached
migrate.unkBody: So this file is treated as shared. Migration stays unavailable until the check answers.
migrate.takenShort: A file named {file} is already there, so nothing was converted.
migrate.takenBody: Nothing on disk was touched. Move or remove that file, then check again.
migrate.roomShort: Not enough free space on this disk: {need} needed, {free} free.
migrate.roomBody: The conversion needs room for a second copy of the file while it runs. Free some space, then check again.
migrate.whyNeeded: Why it came up: AVI can’t store a language for {track}, so {lang} needs a conversion to MKV.
migrate.pathBody: The recorded path does not match the source file; migration is unavailable until the path is resolved
migrate.step3: Put the new file in place
migrate.orig: The original stays untouched until the re-check passes.
migrate.leave: You can leave this page. The job keeps running on the server — follow it in Activity ▸ Jobs.
migrate.origKept: original · kept in a hidden folder
migrate.others: Other devices still see the old file until Jellyfin has indexed the new one.
migrate.radarr: Radarr hasn’t taken the new file — re-link it in Radarr.
migrate.failTitle: The conversion to MKV didn’t finish
migrate.failBody: Nothing was put in place. The original {file} is untouched and still there.
migrate.unvTitle: Migration failed — no language tag after the re-check
migrate.unvBody: The copy step reported success, but re-checking the new file found no language on {track}. The new file was not put in place, and the original {file} is untouched.
migrate.offBody: The conversion runs on the server and isn’t affected. Status updates when the connection returns.
